body: I saved the cloth with white crystals for you. The seed trial crew passed Monday morning; my eyes began burning, and afterward the county van arrived.
title: Monday morning — white crystals
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same white crystals while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
I made a hat to keep the rain off the radio. It looked ridiculous, so nobody noticed when I carried it from room to room.

The same street names came through three times. After the second reading a visitor told us the broadcast had never happened and asked for the radio.

I took the battery out first. The station may be silent now, but I want to know what it says if it comes back.
title: The person at the window
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
